title: dryopteris affinis subsp. stilluppensis
intro: Dryopteris affinis subsp. stilluppensis, commonly known as the male fern, is a species of fern belonging to the family Dryopteridaceae. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects, which can help in wound healing and soothing digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as a diuretic, helping to reduce fluid retention, and as an expectorant, aiding in the relief of respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Dryopteris affinis subsp. stilluppensis include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
